test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding clutches used in vehicles?

options.text: This allows the driver to lift and unload bulk materials from the engine and transmission.
This allows the driver to change the engine's speed in any direction.
This allows the driver to change the engine speed.
This allows the driver to couple or decouple the power transmission as desired without stopping the engine.

solution:
The correct answer is __This allows the driver to couple or decouple the power transmission as desired without stopping the engine__.

__Key Points__</
